name: Akagi, rebuilt1938 / Midway1942
axes: right-handed: X bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
configuration: Rebuilt1938 fit for Midway1942: full-length single flying deck, small port island, one large downturned starboard funnel, three lifts, six aft200mm casemates and six twin120mm AA mounts. No forward twin200mm turrets, lower flying-off decks or radar.
accuracy: Independently authored detailed exterior reconstruction for the June1942 demonstration. Major class configuration is source-backed. Hull body sections, small station offsets, doors, rails and plating are inferred original artwork. Not a recovered shipyard model and not a claim that every small AA fitting or paint patch is exact. One stored GLB supplies every view; no interior is modeled.
geometrySource: New class-specific full exterior and station ledger. No campaign carrier mesh or previous vertex buffer is reused.

sources.title: NHHC archival Akagi photograph NH73058 / NH73059
sources.license: Factual reference only; original mesh and surface detail. Source illustration not redistributed or traced.
sources.usedFor: Inspected archival photograph NH73058 / NH73059: island side/longitudinal station, flight-deck overhang, hangar massing and funnel arrangement. Midway photographs corroborate the overall fit; fine fittings are inferred.

sources.title: Navypedia Akagi,1938 modernization factual record
sources.license: Factual reference only; original mesh and surface detail. Source illustration not redistributed or traced.
sources.usedFor: Bulged hull, full-length249.2x30.5m flight deck, three differently sized lifts, port island, one downturned funnel; six single200mm and six twin120mm guns.

dimensionBasis: Dimensions from the named source with hull beam separated from flight-deck breadth. Hull sections and deck heights are inferred from recognition/archival views.
layoutProvenance: New 1942 demo-specific authoring record, independent of early-conversion campaign assets.

fitReview.status: Dated exterior reconstruction; major features reviewed, small fittings inferred
fitReview.stationAxes: x bow-positive; y starboard-positive; z above waterline, metres
notes: The 1927 three-deck campaign mesh is never used for this1942 record. A new full-length deck, bulged hull and port island replace that earlier layout. Elevator sizes are individually recorded; stations, deck height and small fittings are inferred.

materialSources.name: Original fleet paint, timber, nonslip decking and canvas PBR maps
materialSources.author: WNT1922
materialSources.usage: Embedded physically scaled albedo, OpenGL normal and packed occlusion/roughness/metalness. Original inferred weathering, not an exact camouflage or refit claim.

surfaceProfile.geometryPolicy: Preserve hull loft, fittings and weapon stations. Reduced cylinder and ring tessellation adds at most 3 mm radial error; already coarser original fittings are unchanged. Lossless Float32 vertex indexing preserves UV and hard-normal seams.
